title: Every decompression runs under two numbers, and neither has a spelling for "off"
scope:

summary.headline: Decompression runs under a size ceiling and a ratio, and neither turns off
summary.body:
Inflating compressed input, whether a gzip body or a zip entry, is bounded by an absolute output
size and by the ratio of output to input, together, because a small bomb beats one and a large
honest file beats the other. `[limits] max_decompressed` and `[limits] max_decompression_ratio`
are the operator's, default to 64 MiB and 1000 to 1, and a call may ask for less but never for
more. `false`, which means no ceiling elsewhere, means the shipped default here. Crossing either
bound throws; nothing is ever silently truncated.
